jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON HAIR PERFUME 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
A hair perfume enriched with Pro-Vitamin B5, scented with the iconic Fashionably London fragrance. Ideal for layering with the Eau de Parfum for a more intense olfactory experience. Inspired by the relaxed sophistication of London, this fragrance combines the luminous freshness of bergamot with the modern femininity of rose and the enveloping softness of musk.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Musky Floral | Elegant, luminous, and contemporary
